values: Students: open the Student Sign-up sheet, enter your details in one empty row, and select a team from the drop-down list. Each team has four places.
Use one shared copy in OneDrive, SharePoint, or Google Drive so that all students edit the same file.
After registration closes, add students to the matching GitHub organization team.
